taste:
This crumble combines tart Bramley apples, sweet blackberries and a thick, buttery topping, giving it a clear contrast between sharp fruit and richness. The baked filling is soft, while the golden crumble adds crunch. Blackberries bring a deeper fruity flavour than the apple alone, along with a purple colour through the filling. It suits someone who wants sweetness balanced by a noticeable tart edge.

The description recommends serving it piping hot with creamy custard. That combination brings together crunchy topping, soft fruit and a smooth accompaniment rather than relying on sweetness alone. Check the serving details with your pub, particularly whether custard is included.
